question: Simhastha fair is held in Ujjain on the bank of which river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kshipra River.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Simhastha fair** is a major Hindu festival that is held every **12 years** in the city of **Ujjain **in **Madhya Pradesh, India.**
 
• It is one of the **four Kumbh Melas**, which are the largest religious gatherings in the world.
 
• The fair is held on the banks of the **Kshipra River, **which is considered a sacred river in Hinduism.
 
• During the fair, millions of devotees take a dip in the river to **cleanse their sins** and attain salvation.
 
• The fair also includes various** religious rituals, cultural events,** and a grand procession of **sadhus and saints.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Son River** is a major tributary of the Ganges River and flows through the states of **Jharkhand, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh.**

 
 
• The oldest river bridge in India, the **Koilwar Bridge**, spans the Sone River and links Patna with Arrah.
 
• The nation over, the Sone River is well-known for its **sand.**
 
 
 
• **The Ganga River** is also known as the **Ganges River** and is considered the most sacred river in Hinduism. 
 
 
• In the state of Uttar Pradesh, the** Haridwar Fair** is held along the Ganga River.
 
 
 
• **Gandak river **is a tributary of the Ganges River and flows through **Nepal and India.**
 
 
• **​**In **Sonepur, Bihar,** at the Ganges River confluence (Gandak), the** Sonepur Cattle Fair** takes place on Kartik Poornima, the full moon day, between the months of **November and December.**
